mechanism_narrative: Persistently depressed WORKPLACES and TRANSIT signal weak commuting flows that continue to suppress discretionary stopovers, so retail-and-recreation mobility remains below its recent 4-week level over the next month.
failure_condition: The next 28 days of RETAIL_REC average higher than the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES and TRANSIT staying near their current depressed levels.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL remains above +30 while PARKS and RETAIL_REC stay deeply negative, households are substituting toward at-home activity and away from discretionary outings, which pushes RETAIL_REC lower within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above 30 for a second consecutive week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 7 days while RESIDENTIAL remains above 30 and PARKS does not recover.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed drop in TRANSIT of more than 3 points week-on-week indicates a fresh mobility restriction or aversion shock that reduces access to retail venues and lowers RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after a >3-point week-on-week drop in TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent recovery in GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES signals broader trip chaining and daytime foot traffic that spills into retail visits, increasing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 4-week mean even though GROCERY_PHARM and WORKPLACES both trend upward for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS after an extended trough indicates improving weather or seasonal outdoor demand, which draws people into mixed-use trips and raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from its current 4-week average
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 14 days after PARKS rises by 5 points or more.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL is high and TRANSIT remains near its current trough, people consolidate activity near home and avoid shopping districts, causing RETAIL_REC to stay below the last 4-week average over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC averages higher over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays elevated and TRANSIT stays depressed.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM rises above its current level after a decline, it marks a partial normalization in permitted movement and errands, and retail-and-recreation mobility will improve within one week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM increases for 2 consecutive weeks from its current trough
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM posts two consecutive weekly increases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT from their present depressed levels creates a commuting-led demand base for lunchtime and after-work shopping, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both rise at least 2 points from their current 4-week means
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stays flat or falls over the next 28 days despite concurrent improvements in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.
